scientific_integrity: A complete elementary proof is supplied; Python graph enumeration for ring sizes 5 through 20 and coefficient identities through 75 are supplementary finite checks. No claim of independent certification or historical first discovery.
scientific_limitations: Labelled simple cycles of at least five vertices and strictly exact-two-hop moves only; graph connectivity, shortest paths, other hop distances and priority among unindexed works not established.
title: Exact two-hop mobility spectrum of independent sets on cycles
